name: Before the Doors Open
why_it_works: Customers only ever see the finished room. Showing the dark, quiet hours before opening, with real clock times on screen, proves effort without bragging. Timestamps feel like evidence, and the early hour earns quiet respect.

hook.pattern: Open on a real early clock time and one unglamorous task, no greeting.
examples: You walk in later. We started at {{open_time}}.
The part of {{brand}} you never get to see.

variables.name: open_time
variables.description: The real time the first person arrives

variables.name: signature_item
variables.description: The thing customers come in for

variables.name: prep_task
variables.description: The slow prep job nobody sees
variables.example: laminating butter into dough by hand

variables.name: staff_role
variables.description: Who opens up, written to start a sentence

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Reason to come in, a full sentence starting with a capital, 8 words or fewer
variables.example: First 20 customers get a free coffee

visual.prompt: Dark empty {{brand}} interior before opening, one overhead light on, chairs still stacked on tables, phone-shot realism, vertical 9:16

beats.purpose: first task: lights and machines on

visual.prompt: Hand flipping a wall light switch, room lighting up row by row, slight handheld shake, cool blue pre-dawn light through windows, vertical 9:16
Close-up of hands doing {{prep_task}} for the {{signature_item}} on a worn work counter, warm work light, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16
Detail shot of a worn handwritten prep checklist taped to a wall in the {{brand}} back room, coffee ring stain, tungsten light, vertical 9:16
Same {{brand}} room now bright and open, {{signature_item}} ready for the first customers, morning sun, vertical 9:16

cta: Come see what the early hours made. {{offer}}.

craft.notes: Every beat gets a real clock time or a time cue so the edit reads as a log, not an ad. Keep the dark-to-bright light change as the visual arc: the room literally wakes up.

do_not: Fake an early time you do not actually keep
Glamorize the room with perfect light in the pre-open beats; the dimness is the proof
Show staff who have not agreed to be filmed
